ticker_news.title: 2 Dividend ETFs to Buy With $500 and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: The article recommends two dividend ETFs for long-term investors with $500: the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) with a high 3.7% yield and 100 holdings, and the Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIG) with a lower 1.6% yield but higher growth potential and 338 holdings. Both offer diversification, stability, and passive income through established companies, though they underperform growth stocks in bull markets.
ticker_news.author: Jennifer Saibil

ticker_news.title: Nerdio Strengthens Executive Team with Appointment of Scott Manchester as Chief Product and Technology Officer
ticker_news.description: Nerdio announced the appointment of Scott Manchester, a 25-year Microsoft veteran, as Chief Product & Technology Officer. Manchester will lead the company's product and technology strategy, unifying Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Technology Operations, and Product Support. The move is intended to accelerate innovation and scale the platform as Nerdio continues its growth in the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.
ticker_news.author: Not Specified

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Up, S&P 500 And Nasdaq Slip As ADP Jobs Data Signals Modest Rebound— Mobileye, Penguin Solutions In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Wednesday following a strong Tuesday close. ADP reported private-sector job additions of 41,000 in December, signaling modest labor market stabilization. The Dow Jones futures rose 0.04% while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures declined slightly. Key movers included Mobileye jumping 11% on a $900M robotics acquisition, Ventyx surging 68% on Eli Lilly acquisition talks, and AAR Corp rising 5% on better-than-expected earnings.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
